description: This file contains the definition of domain entities related to users, orders, package details, and tracking events within a delivery management system. It includes class definitions, properties, and an enumeration for order status, serving as the core data models for the backend system.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system with properties for identification, contact info, and account creation timestamp.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a delivery order with details such as origin, destination, package info, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: PackageDetails
classes.description: Encapsulates details about the package including description, weight, and dimensions.

classes.name: TrackingEvent
classes.description: Represents an event in the tracking history of an order, including status, location, timestamp, and optional notes.
